column1: # Cases where this crate and xmllint (libxml2 2.9.14) disagree, each with its cause. The test
# tests/oracle.rs fails on any difference not listed here and on any listed one that no longer
# occurs. kind: verdict (validity differs), errors (same verdict, different errors), unsupported
# (this crate refuses the document as unsupported). Spec references are to XML Schema 1.0
# xmllint validates against the complete OASIS UBL 2.1 schema set, which includes the two ETSI
# XAdES schemas; this crate does not ship them (schemas/oasis-ubl-2.1/README.md), so it
# validates XAdES elements laxly, as xs:anyType. The disagreements this causes have an
# explanation that begins with "XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly." They occur
# with the shipped schemas only: the xmllint-oracle example also runs this crate with the
# complete set, and there they must not occur, while every other one must.

column3: explanation

Whitespace written as a CDATA section in element-only content. Part 1 cvc-complex-type.2.3 allows character information items that are whitespace; CDATA section boundaries are not part of the infoset. libxml2 reports any CDATA node in element-only content.
Same as text-cdata-whitespace-in-element-only, with plain whitespace around the CDATA section.

xs:date has whiteSpace collapse (fixed), Part 2 3.2.9: leading and trailing whitespace is removed before the lexical check. libxml2 2.9.14 does not remove it for the date and time types (it does for the other types).
As date-whitespace: one leading space before an xs:date value.
As date-whitespace, for xs:time (Part 2 3.2.8, whiteSpace collapse).
As date-whitespace, for xs:dateTime (Part 2 3.2.7, whiteSpace collapse).

10:15:59.99999999999999999999 is a valid xs:time (seconds below 60, any number of fractional digits, Part 2 3.2.7). libxml2 accumulates the seconds in a double, which rounds to 60, and then rejects them.
Part 2 3.2.7 puts no limit on the number of year digits. libxml2 rejects years that overflow a C long.

The value space of xs:decimal has no digit limit (Part 2 3.2.3; minimally conforming processors must support at least 18 digits). libxml2 rejects decimals with more than 24 significant digits, an implementation limit it does not document. This crate checks the lexical space without limit.
As decimal-25-digits: trailing fractional zeros count towards the libxml2 limit of 24 digits.
As decimal-25-digits, for xs:integer (here ds:X509SerialNumber, which in practice holds X.509 serial numbers of up to 49 digits).
The lexical space of xs:base64Binary (Part 2 3.2.16) admits only the base64 alphabet, padding and single spaces. libxml2 skips every character outside the alphabet, so QU!JD passes there.
As base64-bang, with - and _ (not in the base64 alphabet).
As base64-bang: -_-_ (the URL-safe alphabet) is not base64Binary; libxml2 skips all four characters and accepts the empty value.
xs:anyURI is defined by RFC 2396 as amended by RFC 2732 (Part 2 3.2.17), which adds [ and ] to the reserved characters, allowed in a query. libxml2 checks RFC 3986, which does not allow them there.
As uri-query-brackets: a:b[c is an absolute URI with an opaque part made of uric characters, [ included (RFC 2396 with RFC 2732).

http://host:port/ is a valid RFC 2396 URI: the authority is a registry-based name (reg_name allows :), which RFC 2396 offers besides server-based authorities. libxml2 (RFC 3986) requires a numeric port.
As uri-port-letters: a@b@c is a valid RFC 2396 reg_name (@ is allowed there).
http://host:/ has an empty port, allowed by RFC 2396 (port = *digit) and by RFC 3986 alike; libxml2 rejects it.
http: is not an RFC 2396 URI: an absolute URI needs a hierarchical part or a non-empty opaque part. RFC 3986, which libxml2 checks, allows an empty path.
?q is not an RFC 2396 URI reference: a relative URI needs a path before the query. RFC 3986, which libxml2 checks, allows it.
[:::1] is not an IPv6 address (RFC 2732 requires one inside the brackets). libxml2 accepts any characters between [ and ].
As uri-ipv6-bad: RFC 2732 has no zone identifiers (they were added to RFC 3986 URIs by RFC 6874), so [fe80::1%25eth0] is not a valid host.

The document reuses as ds:Signature/@Id a value that an xml:id attribute in lax extension content also carries. For XML Schema only attributes and elements validated as xs:ID take part in ID uniqueness (Part 1 cvc-id); the xml:id attribute has no declaration and is not one. libxml2 registers xml:id values while parsing and then reports the schema ID as a duplicate.
xsi:type=" xs:token ": Part 1 cvc-elt.4.1 validates the normalized value of xsi:type as an xs:QName, whose whitespace is collapsed. libxml2 resolves the prefix with the spaces kept and fails.

After a child element in simple content (reported by both), libxml2 also validates the value as the empty string and reports it as an invalid xs:decimal. This crate does not check the value of content already reported as invalid. Same verdict.

xsi:type names xs:float, a built-in type the UBL 2.1 schemas do not use and this crate does not implement. The document is refused as unsupported (DocumentError::Unsupported) rather than given a verdict that might be wrong.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:SignaturePolicyIdentifier is a choice of one element; xmllint, with the XAdES schemas, rejects the second xades:SignaturePolicyImplied. Without them both have no declaration and pass as xs:anyType inside ds:Object (lax).

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:MimeType has a simple type in XAdES 1.3.2, so xmllint rejects the child element; without the schema xades:MimeType is validated as xs:anyType, which allows it.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:Include has empty content in XAdES 1.3.2, so xmllint rejects its text; without the schema it is validated as xs:anyType.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As empty-content-text, with a child element in xades:Include.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As empty-content-text, with whitespace and a comment in xades:Include and its boolean attribute referencedData.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES 1.3.2 requires the URI attribute of xades:Include and types referencedData as xs:boolean; without the schema its attributes are not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. The mutated value is that of xades:SigningTime, an xs:dateTime in XAdES 1.3.2 checked by xmllint; without the schema the element is validated as xs:anyType and its value is not checked. The same mutation is checked against the complete OASIS set by the xmllint-oracle example.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As datetime-space (xades:SigningTime).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As datetime-space (xades:SigningTime).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As datetime-space (xades:SigningTime).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As datetime-space (xades:SigningTime).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As datetime-space (xades:SigningTime).

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. The mutated ds:X509SerialNumber is the one in xades:IssuerSerial, whose type (ds:X509IssuerSerialType) XAdES 1.3.2 assigns; ds:X509SerialNumber is a local element of that type, not a global one, so without the schema it has no declaration and its xs:integer value is not checked.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As integer-fraction (ds:X509SerialNumber in xades:IssuerSerial).

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. The value reused by ds:SignatureValue/@Id is that of xades:SignatureTimeStamp/@Id, an xs:ID in XAdES 1.3.2; without the schema that attribute has no declaration, is not an ID, and the value is used once only.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. The Qualifier attribute of xades:Identifier is an enumeration in XAdES 1.3.2 (OIDAsURI, OIDAsURN); without the schema it is not checked.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As enumeration-wrong-case.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:Identifier and xades:DocumentationReference have xs:anyURI content in XAdES 1.3.2; without the schema their values are not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:ClaimedRole (xades:AnyType) has a strict attribute wildcard in XAdES 1.3.2, so xmllint rejects an attribute without a global declaration; without the schema xades:ClaimedRole is validated as xs:anyType, whose attribute wildcard is lax.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As attribute-strict-wildcard, with a namespaced attribute.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xsi:type="xs:decimal" on xades:MimeType: xmllint rejects it because xs:decimal is not derived from the declared xs:string; without the schema the declared type is xs:anyType, from which every type is derived.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xsi:type names xades:XAdESTimeStampType, a type of the XAdES 1.3.2 schema: without that schema the type does not exist, which is an xsi:type error (cvc-elt.4.2).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As xsi-type-restriction-of-abstract, for xades:IncludeType.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As xsi-type-complex-on-anytype: the xsi:type naming xades:IncludeType is reported as unresolved, instead of the missing URI attribute that type requires. Same verdict.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:UnsignedSignatureProperties has a strict wildcard in XAdES 1.3.2, so xmllint rejects an element without a declaration there; without the schema xades:UnsignedSignatureProperties is validated as xs:anyType, whose wildcard is lax.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As signature-strict-wildcard-unknown, with an unqualified element, which the ##other wildcard of xades:UnsignedSignatureProperties does not allow.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES 1.3.2 requires xades:EncapsulatedTimeStamp or xades:XMLTimeStamp in xades:SignatureTimeStamp; without the schema its content is not checked.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:Include must come before ds:CanonicalizationMethod in xades:XAdESTimeStampType; without the schema the order is not checked.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:ReferenceInfo is not allowed after xades:EncapsulatedTimeStamp in xades:XAdESTimeStampType; without the schema the content is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. In xades:CRLIdentifier, XAdES 1.3.2 types xades:IssueTime as xs:dateTime and xades:Number as xs:integer, and the mutation gives both invalid values; without the schema they are not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. In the policy identifier the mutation adds, xades:int (in xades:NoticeNumbers) is an xs:integer in XAdES 1.3.2 and one has the value x; without the schema it is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:SignedDataObjectProperties is a sequence in XAdES 1.3.2 in which xades:DataObjectFormat cannot follow xades:CommitmentTypeIndication; without the schema the order is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As signature-commitment, and xades:CommitmentTypeIndication also holds xades:AllSignedDataObjects where XAdES 1.3.2 expects xades:ObjectReference or xades:CommitmentTypeQualifiers.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xades:UnsignedProperties before xades:SignedProperties breaks the sequence of xades:QualifyingPropertiesType; without the schema the order is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xsi:type names the abstract xades:GenericTimeStampType: xmllint reports the abstract type, this crate the xsi:type that does not resolve without the XAdES schema. Same verdict.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As xsi-type-abstract-on-anytype, in lax extension content. Same verdict.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xsi:nil on xades:SignaturePolicyImplied, whose declaration is not nillable in XAdES 1.3.2; without the schema the element has no declaration, and xsi:nil is checked only against a declaration (cvc-elt.3).
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As empty-content-text, with text and child elements in xades:Include.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xmllint rejects the child of xades:Include (empty content) and does not look into it; without the schema xades:Include is validated as xs:anyType and the cbc:IssueDate inside it, which has a global declaration, is validated: its value is invalid. Same verdict.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. xmllint rejects ex:Unknown, matched by the strict wildcard of xades:UnsignedSignatureProperties; without the schema that wildcard is the lax one of xs:anyType, and the cbc:IssueDate inside ex:Unknown, which has a global declaration, is validated: its value is invalid. Same verdict.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. As signature-strict-wildcard-unknown, followed by xades:Bad, which XAdES 1.3.2 does not declare there; without the schema neither is checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES content as UBL extension content (ext:ExtensionContent, lax wildcard): xades:SigningCertificate before xades:SigningTime breaks the sequence of xades:SignedSignaturePropertiesType; without the schema the order is not checked.
XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES content as UBL extension content: xades:SigningTime is an xs:dateTime in XAdES 1.3.2; without the schema its value is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES content as UBL extension content: XAdES 1.3.2 requires the Target attribute of xades:QualifyingProperties; without the schema it is not checked.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES content as UBL extension content: ds:X509SerialNumber is a local element of ds:X509IssuerSerialType, the type XAdES 1.3.2 gives xades:IssuerSerial; without the schema it has no declaration and its xs:integer value is not checked. (ds:DigestMethod, a global declaration, is still validated there: see xades-extension-ds-missing-algorithm, on which both agree.)

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES content as UBL extension content: xades:NoSuchElement has no declaration in either case (lax), but the xades:SigningTime inside it has a global declaration in XAdES 1.3.2, so xmllint validates its value; without the schema it has none.

XAdES schemas not shipped: content validated laxly. XAdES 1.4.1 content as UBL extension content: XAdES 1.3.2 does not allow xades:Bad in xades:CertificateValues; without the schemas the content is not checked.
